AuthConfig.description: What a client needs to know before anyone has signed in.

devLoginEnabled.description: Whether the development login is available.

googleClientId.description: The Google OAuth client to sign in with; null when Google sign-in is not set up.

Board.description: A heading inspirations are collected under, for example Flowers.

inspirationCount.description: How many inspirations are on it.

Category.description: A heading entries can be filed under, for example Venue.

Entry.description: A plan item or a task.

assigneeIds.description: The members who do it: none, one or both.

completedAt.description: When it was marked done; null otherwise.

conflictsWithIds.description: Those of dependsOnIds that end after this entry is meant to begin.

dependsOnIds.description: The plan items this one waits for: it can only start when they are finished.

dueDate.description: The day a task is due, or the day a plan item ends; null while not scheduled.

parentId.description: Tasks only: the plan item it belongs to.

priority.description: The level chosen by a person (MANUAL) or worked out for today (AUTO).

priorityReason.description: Why the entry has this level.

startDate.description: Plan items only; null for a task.

taskCount.description: For a plan item: how many tasks belong to it.

version.description: Send this back with a change; it tells whether someone else saved in between.

EntryChange.description: All fields of an entry as they should be from now on.

version.description: The version of the entry this change is based on.

idToken.description: The ID token Google handed to the client.

Home.description: What the first page shows: how long until the wedding, and what to do next.

daysLeft.description: Whole days from today to the wedding day: 0 on the day, negative after it; null while the day is not fixed.

next.description: The five unfinished entries to turn to next, by priority and then by date. Overdue entries are not repeated here.

overdue.description: Every unfinished entry whose date has passed, the longest overdue first.

today.description: Today's date where the wedding takes place.

weddingDate.description: The wedding day; null while it is not fixed.

Inspiration.description: An idea the couple kept: a link or pictures, on a board, with a note and tags.

pictures.description: Its pictures, in their order; the first is the one a card shows.

planItemId.description: The plan item the idea belongs to.

previewStatus.description: Whether a title and a picture are still being fetched for the link, were found, or will not come.

previewTitle.description: The title the linked page gives itself; empty when none was fetched. Shown where title is empty.

source.description: Where it comes from, worked out from the link; PHOTO when there is no link.

tags.description: In lower case, in alphabetical order.

url.description: The page the idea comes from; null for pictures of one's own.

version.description: Send this back with a change; it tells whether someone else saved in between.

InspirationChange.description: All fields of an inspiration as they should be from now on.

version.description: The version of the inspiration this change is based on.

NewEntry.description: A plan item or a task to add.

assigneeIds.description: Who does it: none, one or both of the wedding's members.

dueDate.description: The day a task is due, or the day a plan item ends.

parentId.description: Tasks only: the plan item this task belongs to.

priority.description: With priorityMode MANUAL: the chosen priority. With AUTO: null.

startDate.description: Plan items only: the day the step starts. Needs a due date.

NewInspiration.description: An idea to keep: a link, or the start of one that pictures are added to.

boardId.description: The board it goes on; null for none yet.

planItemId.description: The plan item the idea belongs to.

tags.description: Kept in lower case, without a leading #.

url.description: The page the idea comes from, starting with http:// or https://; null for pictures of one's own.

Picture.description: A picture of an inspiration. Its bytes are at /api/inspirations/{inspirationId}/pictures/{id}.

contentType.description: image/jpeg, image/png, image/gif or image/webp, worked out from the file itself.

preview.description: true when the server fetched it from the link; false when a person sent it.

width.description: In pixels, the right way up; null for a kind the server cannot read.

Problem.description: An error, as RFC 9457 problem details.

detail.description: What went wrong this time, if there is more to say.

fieldProblems.description: For a request that is not valid: what is wrong with which field.

field.description: The field's name as the request spells it.

instance.description: The path that was asked for.

status.description: The HTTP status of the response.

title.description: The kind of error in words.

type.description: The kind of error. Clients decide what to do from this value.

refreshToken.description: The refresh token; a browser leaves it out, because its cookie carries it.

Session.description: What a client holds while someone is signed in.

accessToken.description: Sent with every request as 'Authorization: Bearer ...'.

accessTokenExpiresAt.description: When the access token stops working; refresh before then.

refreshToken.description: Exchanged for a new session when the access token expires; used once. Null for a browser: there it travels in a cookie that scripts cannot read.

TagCount.description: A tag in use and how many inspirations carry it.

date.description: The wedding day; null while it is not fixed.

members.description: The two people, in the order of the setup.

date.description: The wedding day; null while it is not fixed.

WeddingMember.description: One of the two people the wedding belongs to.

signedIn.description: Whether this person has signed in to the planner yet.

you.description: Whether this is the person asking.

WeddingSetup.description: The first owner's answers at the setup.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency all amounts are in, for example PLN.

date.description: The wedding day; null while it is not fixed.

partnerName.description: What the planner calls the other person.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone the wedding's dates are read in, for example Europe/Warsaw.

yourName.description: What the planner calls the person setting it up.

parameters.description: For a board with inspirations: keep them without a board, or delete them too.
parameters.name: inspirations

parameters.description: Only entries in one of these states.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Only entries this member does (alone or with the other).
parameters.name: assigneeId

parameters.description: Only the tasks of this plan item.
parameters.name: parentId

parameters.description: true: only entries with a due date; false: only those without.
parameters.name: scheduled

parameters.description: Only entries at one of these levels, as shown today: worked out or set by hand.
parameters.name: priority

parameters.description: For a plan item with tasks: what happens to them. Without it such a plan item is not deleted and the answer is the entry-has-tasks problem.
parameters.name: tasks

parameters.description: Only the inspirations on this board.
parameters.name: boardId

parameters.description: true: only the inspirations that are on no board.
parameters.name: withoutBoard

parameters.description: Only the inspirations that carry this tag.
parameters.name: tag

parameters.description: Only the inspirations that belong to this plan item.
parameters.name: planItemId

files.description: JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP pictures, at most 15 MB each.

parameters.description: THUMBNAIL: the smaller version for a board; the picture itself where there is none.
parameters.name: size

200.description: The picture, or its smaller version as a JPEG.
